full_text_tesim: Arabic translations of sentences from the main text, mostly illegible due to faint ink, ff. 10r-v, 11v, 12v, and others
Binding in fair condition; spine exposed; no pastedown on back cover; loose paper fragment inside front cover
Holy God (= Trisagion); kathisma of the day (= Dismissal); and finish as usual
Iron gall, red and yellow inks used in the text; black, red and yellow colours used in ornamentation
Leather on wood; leather on front cover stitched; leather strap in front cover.
Pencil foliation at either top or bottom of recto
Philothée's catalogue incorrectly dates this manuscript to 917 CE, a date found on the Arabic flyleaves; subsequent catalogues have dated this to the 13th c.
Quire signatures in Syriac on the first page of each quire, in the top margin. Quires of 8 folios, except for quires II (7 folios, lacuna of 1 f.), IX (6 folios), XXI (4 folios).
Two binding boards covered with leather.
Writing on flyleaves: f. 1r–v – Arabic (to be read!), f. 2r – Syriac (prayer), f. 2v – Arabic (to be read!), ff. 162v–163v – Arabic (to be read!)
